```yaml
name: Docs Preview Deploy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["docs-preview-pr"]
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' && github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Download docs preview artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-preview
          path: preview

      - name: Prepare preview folder
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          rm -rf "pr-${PR_NUMBER}"
          mv preview "pr-${PR_NUMBER}"

      - name: Commit and push preview
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "pr-${PR_NUMBER}"
          git commit -m "Deploy docs preview for PR #${PR_NUMBER}"
          git push origin gh-pages

  cleanup:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Remove preview folder
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          git rm -rf --ignore-unmatch "pr-${PR_NUMBER}"
          git commit -m "Remove docs preview for PR #${PR_NUMBER}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin gh-pages
```
